title: Executive sales dashboard
problem: a retail chain whose leadership got a 40-tab spreadsheet every Monday
approach: a star schema and one-page KPI report with drill-through by region
result: weekly reporting time fell from 6 hours to 20 minutes

title: Marketing attribution warehouse
problem: a D2C brand unable to tell which channel drove sales
approach: joined ad spend with web events and orders, then built tested models for each channel
result: reallocated 18% of ad budget and lowered cost per order by 22%

title: dbt project for a fintech warehouse
problem: a fintech with 200 untested SQL views nobody trusted
approach: layered staging, intermediate and mart models with tests and docs
result: data incidents fell from weekly to one per quarter

title: Churn analysis for a subscription box
problem: a meal-kit company losing 9% of subscribers monthly
approach: cohort retention curves and survival analysis by acquisition channel
result: identified a first-box issue; fixing it cut month-1 churn by 3 points

title: A/B test analysis for pricing page
problem: a SaaS team arguing over a pricing-page test with no clear result
approach: pre-registered metrics, sample-size checks and a sequential test
result: declared a winner with 95% confidence; annual-plan uptake rose 11%

title: Tableau operations workbook
problem: a hospital tracking bed occupancy on whiteboards
approach: a workbook fed from the admissions database with hourly refresh
result: average discharge delay reduced by 50 minutes

title: Nightly ETL from five SaaS tools
problem: an agency copying CSVs from five tools every morning
approach: scheduled loaders with retries, deduplication and a reconciliation report
result: saved 10 staff hours a week; zero missed loads in 4 months

title: Google Sheets automation for a non-profit
problem: a non-profit merging donor lists by hand
approach: scripted imports, duplicate detection and a free donor dashboard

title: Revenue forecasting model
problem: a SaaS finance team forecasting revenue with gut feel
approach: a driver-based model of new, expansion and churned revenue with scenario inputs
result: quarterly forecast error fell from 14% to 4%

title: Redshift cost and performance tuning
problem: a media company whose dashboards took two minutes to load
approach: sort and distribution keys, materialised aggregates and query rewrites
result: median dashboard query from 110 s to 9 s and 30% lower cluster spend

title: Metabase self-serve analytics
problem: ops managers waiting days for every data question
approach: curated models and 25 saved questions with plain-language descriptions
result: ad-hoc data requests to the engineering team down 65%

title: Survey analysis in R
problem: an NGO with 6,000 survey responses and no analyst
approach: weighted estimates, regression on outcomes and a clear PDF report
result: report cited in the NGO's grant renewal that secured funding for two more years

title: E-commerce cohort and LTV dashboard
problem: a Shopify brand guessing customer lifetime value
approach: monthly cohorts, repeat-purchase curves and LTV by first product
result: shifted acquisition to two hero products with 1.8x higher LTV

title: Data cleaning of a 2-million-row CRM export
problem: a B2B distributor with duplicated, mis-typed customer records
approach: fuzzy matching, address standardisation and a review sheet for edge cases
result: 2.1 million rows reduced to 640,000 unique customers with an audit trail

title: Fivetran and Snowflake setup
problem: a startup with data scattered across HubSpot, Stripe and Postgres
approach: managed connectors into a raw layer, then tested models for finance
result: first trustworthy MRR number within 10 days

title: Inventory KPI dashboard in Excel
problem: a small factory with no view of slow-moving stock
approach: pivot models, lookups and a printable KPI sheet
result: freed PKR 4 million of tied-up inventory within a quarter
